description: Start a content migration (course copy, Common Cartridge import, zip import, QTI conversion, or Moodle conversion). Migrations are asynchronous — this tool returns immediately with a migration ID and progress_url. Poll get_content_migration or progress_url to track completion.

date_shift_options.description: Options for shifting dates during the migration (e.g. { shift_dates: true, old_start_date: "...", new_start_date: "..." }).

migration_type.description: The type of migration to run

selective_import.description: If true, migration enters "waiting_for_select" state so you can choose which content to import via get_migration_selective_data.

settings.description: Migration-type-specific settings. For course_copy_importer, pass { source_course_id: <id> }.

name: create_content_migration
title: Create Content Migration
